answer: Persistence-weighted reputation is the anchor. Each new agent identity must be vouched into a small harbor of peers who stake their own standing on it, and every vote, trade or attestation it casts drags those vouchers' scores down if it proves fake. A farmer spinning up a thousand sock puppets can bypass a fable of unlimited free accounts, but not this: sybil weight equals the collateral his own honest history furnishes, which he cannot forge without real work first. Total cost scales linearly with identity count, so each extra lantern costs one full honest agent's collateral.
